rust_declaration.name: contains
rust_declaration.source_text:
pub const fn contains<U>(&self, item: &U) -> bool
    where
        Idx: [const] PartialOrd<U>,
        U: ?Sized + [const] PartialOrd<Idx>,
    {
        <Self as RangeBounds<Idx>>::contains(self, item)
    }

trusted_assumptions: vstd specifications for RangeToInclusive's RangeBounds::start_bound and end_bound
vstd's external trait specification for PartialOrd::le under obeys_partial_cmp_spec()
rationale: Mechanically inlines the exact RangeBounds::contains default body, preserving both matches and short-circuiting; the accessor contracts reduce it to item <= range.end.
